dataset.name: Indian gingivobuccal oral squamous carcinoma (ICGC ORCA-IN)
dataset.description: Independent Indian gingivobuccal oral squamous-cell carcinoma cohort with open ICGC Release 28 bulk RNA-seq and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Primary gingivobuccal oral squamous-cell carcinomas from an Indian population in which smokeless-tobacco exposure is common. The anatomically focused cohort is retained separately from broader TCGA-HNSC and other head-and-neck series.
dataset.publication_citation: India Project Team of the ICGC. Nature Communications 2013

metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, while direct matrix download remains disabled pending a dedicated ICGC redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: TRACE Explorer requires an endpoint-complete donor and an open RefSeq/FPKM RNA-seq analysis linked to a primary solid tumor annotated as squamous-cell carcinoma (ICD-O 8070/3). One analysis is selected deterministically per donor.

expression.label: log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The ICGC adapter applies source.duplicate_gene_policy before this matrix is materialized. Repeated RefSeq symbols without a disambiguating source identifier are removed rather than aggregated, so the matrix supplied to the generic builder is unique.
expression.scale_note: ICGC provides non-negative FPKM values. TRACE Explorer removes repeated source symbols rather than aggregating them, retains complete unique symbols and applies log2(value + 1) once.
